notes: 22-31 strip x 5440-7040 (picks to x~5120-7390). Names from the plate; suffixes as printed: Pinetree, Hiawatha and Canton have none. Queen City Avenue along the top edge; Westwood Avenue (centre y~1150 west of Mohawk) turns ENE at Mohawk, bends at (6290,1025) and forks into Harrison at ~(7098,864). Harrison Avenue: the streetcar road crossing Queen City at (6590,325) and curving SSE->ESE; its NW leg north of Queen City is cut by the plate edge and only label fragments show. Lick Run Alley is printed east of the strip (x~7350); its west end is at Harrison. Unnamed (?) streets printed only STREET: the 40 ft E-W dead-end street off Mohawk (y~1485), the diagonal dead-end street off Mohawk, the 50 ft N-S streets at x~6505 and x~6953 (Henry Grotenkemper tract, ending at the Chas. Lehman's Subdiv. line y~3725), the 40 ft E-W streets at y~2119 and y~3225, the 40 ft street reaching Lehman from the NNW at x~5236 (others call it Orange Street's south section). The 20 ft way printed LANE runs Tait -> Ashley -> (unlabelled) -> Canton. Orange Street: ORANGE printed on the SW section west of the strip and STREET on the NE section (same straight line through the Clara/Felton junction); the NE section dead-ends at a lot line short of Selim. Pinetree, Detroit Street and the Wallace south stub are cut by the plate edge; their names follow the 22-31R / 22-29 readings. State Avenue carries the railroad tracks in its corridor; crossings use the corridor centre. Not streets: BARRSVILLE SUBDIV'N, HENRY WINNER'S EST., MRS. FRANK'S SUB, R.A. JAMES SUB, GERRARD & COOPER'S SUB, ERNST'S 2ND SUB, HENRY GROTENKEMPER, CHAS. LEHMAN'S SUBDIV'N, EDWARD DODSON lettering; the railroads crossing the Barrsville and Ernst tracts; the sewer strip west of Harrison on Lick Run Alley's line. The unnamed strip from (5287,5822) to Lehman at (5640,6450) may be a private lane.
